```python
from griffe.loader import GriffeLoader

loader = GriffeLoader()

# Load package at v1.0.0
old = loader.load_from_git("mypkg", ref="v1.0.0")

# Load package at HEAD
new = loader.load_from_git("mypkg", ref="HEAD")

# Iterate over breaking changes
for breakage in old.get_breaking_changes(new):
    print(breakage)
```
